start.speaker: Narrator
start.text: Your final piece is swept from the board. The game is over. Anubis's gaze, heavy as a pyramid stone, falls upon you.

ADD2.speaker: Anubis
ADD2.text: The scales have tipped... against you, mortal. A life is forfeit. A deal is a deal.

ADD3.speaker: Player
ADD3.text: No... wait! There has to be another way! Please!

ADD4.speaker: Kronos
ADD4.text: Whoa, whoa, hold on, Anubis! Let's not be hasty! A life? We didn't *really* agree to that, did we? It was more of a... a gentleman's wager!

ADD5.speaker: Anubis
ADD5.text: Your memory is as fleeting as the mortals you toy with, Kronos. The wager was clear. The soul is mine.

ADD6.speaker: Narrator
ADD6.text: Anubis raises a hand, and shadows begin to coalesce around you, cold and suffocating. Your vision begins to fade.

ADD7.speaker: Kronos
ADD7.text: Not on my watch! I can't lose my star player! Think, Kronos, think... time... of course! Time!

ADD8.speaker: Anubis
ADD8.text: What trickery is this? You would dare interfere with the sacred balance?

ADD9.speaker: Kronos
ADD9.text: It's not a trick, it's a do-over! A mulligan! A... temporal adjustment! Hold on tight, my friend, this might feel a bit strange!

end.speaker: Narrator
end.text: The world dissolves into a dizzying swirl of colors and sounds. The cold grip of the shadows recedes as you feel yourself pulled backwards, through moments, until everything snaps back into focus...
